games.headline: Detroit’s spacing meets Boston’s perimeter offense.
games.analysis: Our working script is a competitive game with Boston leaning on Tatum’s perimeter scoring and Detroit using Cunningham’s creation to find shooters. games.winnerReason: Script lean: Detroit’s ball movement and perimeter finishing hold up at home. Boston’s new lineup and Tatum’s scoring are the main threats.
